title: 'Silver Surfer' video, Bill Nye's brine-shrimp claim, and the Red Bull skydiver debunk

tellings.quote: I posted cuz I saw this thing in the sky and I didn't know what it was. I filmed it. It's called the I called it the Silver Surfer.

plain: In 2008, over Santa Monica, California, the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell says he saw something in the sky he could not identify, filmed it, posted the footage, and named it the Silver Surfer. Corbell tells this as the person who shot it, and the story as he tells it also involves the television science educator Bill Nye offering an explanation involving brine shrimp, and a later claim that it was a Red Bull skydiver, which Corbell treats as explanations to be knocked down.
